title: Bernalillo County Open Space Holdings
discovery_method: Deterministic ArcGIS REST service, layer-metadata, and feature-count review

service.description: This polygon feature class is Bernalillo County real estate holdings in Bernalillo County, NM. It is a combination of the "Bernalillo County Properties", "Fire & Rescue Facilities", "Sheriff's Office Facilities", "Open Space Properties", and "Parks & Recreation Facilities" feature classes.
